content: Command palette (Cmd+K) conventions: modal dialog (CommandDialog pattern), trigger via Cmd+K plus a visible search button with kbd hint; grouped results in labeled sections (navigation, actions, recent); default/empty-query state shows recent items or top actions; CommandEmpty for no-match; full keyboard nav (arrows, Enter commit, Esc close), typeahead filtering, groups auto-hide when empty. Sources: uxpatterns.dev, solomon.io (ex-Linear designer), shadcn/ui Command docs.
